news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹81.52 (vs ₹1.26 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹81.52 (up from ₹1.26 in FY 2025). Net income: ₹11.9b (up ₹11.7b from FY 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 135% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 24% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: An undisclosed buyer acquired 90% stake in Marathalli Ventures Private Limited from Satchmo Holdings Limited (BSE:533202).
news.body:
An undisclosed buyer executed the Share Purchase Agreement to acquire 90% stake in Marathalli Ventures Private Limited from Satchmo Holdings Limited (BSE:533202) on January 10, 2026.

The transaction is subject to approval of merger agreement by target board. The deal has been approved by the board.

An undisclosed buyer completed the acquisition of 90% stake in Marathalli Ventures Private Limited from Satchmo Holdings Limited (BSE:533202) on January 10, 2026.

news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.6% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months (8.6% average weekly change). Negative equity (-₹10b).
